sloka: श्रुता हि दृष्टाश्च मया पराक्रमा महात्मनस्तस्य रणावमर्दिनः ।न देवगन्धर्वभुजङ्गराक्षसा भवन्ति रामेण समा हि संयुगे ।। ५.३७.६३।।।।
transliteration: śrutā hi dṛṣṭāśca mayā parākramā mahātmanastasya raṇāvamardinaḥ ।na devagandharvabhujaṅgarākṣasā bhavanti rāmeṇa samā hi saṁyuge ।। 5.37.63।।।।

translations.english: "It will be proper if Rama comes here, kills Ravana along with all his relations and takes me away.
